Sound StackTeacher-led phonics cards

Teacher setup & sources

Changes are saved in this browser when local storage is available. Download a deck as a backup. No student information is collected. Cue pictures are draft selections from the UFLI deck; /r/ has an uncertain keyword. This is a classroom tool, not an official IMSE product.

Keyboard: ← / → flip a review card. On the blending board, 1 / 2 / 3 advance the three piles (Shift reverses). Escape leaves presentation view. Click a card to advance. No automatic audio or word-validity claims.
